materials.name: QingHuiStrata
materials.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: production PBR seamless tileable BASE COLOR texture, exactly square, preferably 1024 x 1024, filling every pixel. Primary request: a premium natural weathered blue-grey stratified slate/siltstone surface for a solemn ancient Chinese Qin-era stonemason ruin and rocky mountain. Orthographic straight-on/top-down texture scan, zero perspective, no object silhouette or background. Color: muted desaturated blue charcoal grey, medium-dark average RGB roughly 75-100, very subtle mineral variation; no painted cyan, no saturated colors. Intricate physically believable irregular layered stone plates, thin discontinuous sediment laminations, uneven fractured facets, small chipped edges, occasional hairline quartz seams, embedded fine grain, smooth eroded spots alternating with rough chipped patches. Several scales of detail, non-repeating natural distribution. Mostly short oblique/horizontal strata interrupted by crossing fractures, no manufactured wall blocks or regular grout grid. Delit/albedo appearance: perfectly diffuse even illumination, NO directional light, NO cast shadows, NO bright edge lighting, no baked specular highlights, no vignette, no ambient shadow gradient. Texture must tile seamlessly on BOTH axes: carefully continue all patterns at opposite edges, full bleed with no border, no central hero rock or giant focal crack. Approximate physical coverage 2 metres square, close-up material-only detail. No text, no captions, no panel layout, no ruler, no watermark. Output ONLY the basecolor bitmap, not a rendered sphere or a sample board.

materials.name: MossScree
materials.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: production PBR seamless tileable BASE COLOR texture, exactly square, preferably 1024 x 1024, filling every pixel. Primary request: a premium muted grey-green moss and slate scree ground material for a solemn ancient Chinese Qin-era engineering ruin in a rocky valley. Orthographic directly overhead texture scan, zero perspective, no object silhouette/background. Physically believable small angular blue-grey slate chips, scattered larger thin worn slate flakes, compact dark mineral grit and fine sand; soft sparse low growing grey-olive moss in irregular branching patches between stones, about 25-35% coverage. Moss is tiny close cropped cushion texture, no grass blades, no leafy plants. Fine grain and chipped stone edges, natural asymmetry and multi-scale detail, no dominant central object. Palette low saturation cool grey stones with subdued grey-olive moss, charcoal interstitial earth, average muted mid-dark values; no bright emerald grass, no orange soil, no fantasy colored veins. Delit/albedo appearance: perfectly diffuse uniform illumination, NO directional lighting, no cast shadows, NO black ambient-occlusion crevices, no strong baked brightness gradient, no specular highlights, no vignette. Seamless on BOTH axes: natural patterns continue at opposite edges, full bleed, no border, no obvious repeated checkerboard motifs. Approximate physical coverage 1.5 metres square. No text, no labels, no watermark, no extra panels. Output ONLY the flat basecolor bitmap, not a rendered sphere or material sample board.
